# Disclaimer on Data and Sources

**Important Note on Sources and URLs:**
Per the system instructions prohibiting web searches and the fabrication of URLs, specific verifiable hyperlinks to primary documents (e.g., Ministry of Industry and Trade PDFs, EVN Annual Reports) cannot be provided in this output.
